args.question: I need clarification on two things: 1) Where is the CO2 impact data stored? I don't see a CO2 field in the environmentalmonitoring or shipments tables. result: The CO2 impact is stored in the `carbonkg` column of the `reviewsandimprovements` table. content: I need clarification on two things: 1) Where is the CO2 impact data stored? I don't see a CO2 field in the environmentalmonitoring or shipments tables. Could you tell me which column/JSONB path contains CO2 impact information? 2) For "very late" shipments, should I use the 'Severely Delayed' category from the Delivery Performance Classification (shipments >24 hours after scheduled time), calculated as actual_duration_hrs - planned_eta_hrs > 24?

args.sql:
SELECT 
    r.reckeyrev,
    r.carbonkg,
    s.shipment_overview->'timing_performance'->>'actual_duration_hrs' as actual_dur,
    s.shipment_overview->'timing_performance'->>'planned_eta_hrs' as planned_eta
FROM reviewsandimprovements r
JOIN shipments s ON r.reckeyrev = s.reckey
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    AVG(r.carbonkg) as avg_co2_kg
FROM reviewsandimprovements r
JOIN shipments s ON r.reckeyrev = s.reckey
WHERE CAST(s.shipment_overview->'timing_performance'->>'actual_duration_hrs' AS numeric) - CAST(s.shipment_overview->'timing_performance'->>'planned_eta_hrs' AS numeric) > 24;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as severely_delayed_count,
    AVG(r.carbonkg) as avg_co2_kg
FROM reviewsandimprovements r
JOIN shipments s ON r.reckeyrev = s.reckey
WHERE CAST(s.shipment_overview->'timing_performance'->>'actual_duration_hrs' AS numeric) - CAST(s.shipment_overview->'timing_performance'->>'planned_eta_hrs' AS numeric) > 24;
